mapper.select: SELECT coupon_id FROM ( (SELECT coupon_id FROM seckill_message_log WHERE coupon_id>#{afterCouponId} GROUP BY coupon_id ORDER BY coupon_id LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT coupon_id FROM seckill_compensation_record WHERE coupon_id>#{afterCouponId} GROUP BY coupon_id ORDER BY coupon_id LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT id AS coupon_id FROM seckill_coupon WHERE id>#{afterCouponId} AND status=1 AND start_time IS NOT NULL AND start_time<=NOW() AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time>=NOW() ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}) ) candidates GROUP BY coupon_id ORDER BY coupon_id LIMIT #{limit}
